name: sonars
description: SONARS — Signal Observation, Navigation, Analysis & Response System for Devign Digital

scripts.lint: node scripts/validate-js.js && python3 -c "import pathlib, py_compile, sys; files = [p for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py')) if not any(x in p.parts for x in ('node_modules','.git','data','logs','dist','__pycache__'))]; [py_compile.compile(str(f), doraise=True) for f in files]; print(f'Validated {len(files)} Python file(s) individually.')"
scripts.test: node --test tests/node/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/python -p 'test_*.py'
